_meta.purpose: Curated watch for hidden/undervalued assets inside distressed or levered capital structures, where a CREDIT AGREEMENT mandates disposition proceeds to debt paydown -- an INCENTIVISED, revealed path to value realisation. On a small equity base, a mandatory-prepayment asset sale is stub-accretive: $X of proceeds retires $X of debt, lifting equity ~$X. Monitor the catalyst triggers; the credit-agreement structure is the mechanism.
_meta.fields: hidden_asset, thesis, credit_agreement_feature, catalyst_triggers (phrases to watch in filings/news), counter_risks
_meta.refresh: hand-curated from filings + credit agreements; credit_agreement_mine.py auto-detects the mandatory-prepayment structure across the universe.

SSP.name: E.W. Scripps
SSP.hidden_asset: ATSC 3.0 broadcast spectrum (~0.8-1.3bn MHz-pops via ION); flexible-use / datacasting (EdgeBeam 25%); potential lease/sale to carriers or SpaceX/Starlink
SSP.thesis: Nationwide low-band wireless pipes inside a distressed media capital structure. Market does not need $3bn realisation for the equity to change radically -- a $300-500m selective monetisation is already material on the small equity base.
SSP.credit_agreement_feature: April 2026 credit agreement anticipates sale of spectrum usage rights and broadcast licences; after a small threshold, substantially 100% of net cash disposal proceeds are subject to MANDATORY term-loan repayment (70/30 B-2/B-3), up to $50m/yr permitted reinvestment. Deleveraging mechanically transfers value from lenders to the small common-equity stub.
counter_risks: FCC owns the rulebook -- no unilateral conversion to 5G/satellite
opportunity cost: profitable EdgeBeam lease raises the cost of selling
not every station equivalent (UHF/VHF, population, channel-share status)
creditors paid first -- judge by equity value after lost station EBITDA
